Senses.Explanation: Are the eyebrows still there? is Cuiyan Lingcan’s summer-end question after speaking for the assembly. Later records raise his exact question and make speakers risk their own eyebrows in the same public-speech test. one case-question: original, quoted reprise, and self-directed reprise retain the eyebrow stake still there supplies the live yes-or-no challenge; bare eyebrows has wider bodily and metaphorical deployments. The line about exerting oneself for the assembly states the danger of public speech but is not silently merged into the eyebrow question.
